adversarial.text: Iran (life expectancy ~77, valid here) and Afghanistan count as Southern Asia under the UN geoscheme. Many players treat Iran as Middle East/Western Asia and Afghanistan as Central Asia, and the notes only say Central and Western Asia are excluded. Players may dispute both inclusions, or think other Middle East countries should count too.
